item.description: Upper airway cough syndrome (UACS) is one of the most common causes of subacute and chronic cough. Several different etiologies lead to UACS, which is thought to be caused by postnasal drip ± sensitization of cough receptors in the respiratory tract.

item.title: Cough in Adults - Pulmonology - Merck Manual Professional Edition
item.description: Purely psychogenic cough is a diagnosis of exclusion. However, patients with chronic cough may develop a secondary reflex or psychogenic component to their cough. Protracted coughing may injure the bronchial mucosa, which may trigger more coughing.
